title: Whose It Is
label: ch:ml-genitive
canDo: I can say that any noun owns something, not only that I do.

payoff.summary: From cold: both genitive endings, what decides between them, and the owner-first order the phrase always takes.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these two atoms and the payoff assesses both. No new noun is added: adhyaapakan, amma and pustakam are all taught, and the suffix was already visible inside enre.
